p_var_decl.brief: 解析变量声明列表 / Parse a variable declaration list

params.kind: 声明关键字（`var`/`let`/`const`）/ The declaration keyword (`var`/`let`/`const`)

p_var_decl.note: 每项是可省初值的 `JS_N_ASSIGN`（`op` 为 `JS_OP_SET`）/ Each item is a `JS_N_ASSIGN` (`op` = `JS_OP_SET`) with an optional initialiser

p_block.brief: 解析 `{ … }` 语句块 / Parse a `{ … }` statement block
p_block.warning: 块内出现 `T_EOF` 时报错 / Errors when `T_EOF` appears inside the block

p_function_body.brief: 解析函数体 / Parse a function body
p_function_body.return: 函数体块节点 / The body block node

p_for_each.brief: 解析 `for (… of …)` / `for (… in …)` 头 / Parse a `for (… of …)` / `for (… in …)` head

params.decl_off: 目标前有 var/let/const 关键字时为 1 / 1 when a var/let/const keyword precedes the target

p_for_each.return: `JS_N_FORIN` 或 `JS_N_FOROF` 节点 / A `JS_N_FORIN` or `JS_N_FOROF` node
p_for_each.note: `decl_off` 非 0 时把绑定目标包进 `JS_N_VAR` / A non-zero `decl_off` wraps the binding target in a `JS_N_VAR`

p_for_classic.brief: 解析经典三段式 `for (;;)` 头 / Parse the classic three-part `for (;;)` head
p_for_classic.note: init/cond/update 各段缺失时放入 `NULL` / Missing init/cond/update parts are stored as `NULL`

p_for.brief: 解析 `for` 语句（含 `for await`）/ Parse a `for` statement (including `for await`)
p_for.return: 经典 `for`、`for-of` 或 `for-in` 节点 / A classic `for`, `for-of` or `for-in` node
p_for.note: 按头部形态分派给 `p_for_each` 或 `p_for_classic` / Dispatches to `p_for_each` or `p_for_classic` based on the head

p_switch.note: 每个 case/default 子句是一个 `JS_N_BLOCK`，首子节点为测试表达式或 `NULL` / Each case/default clause is a `JS_N_BLOCK` whose first child is the test expression or `NULL`
p_switch.warning: 非 case/default 开始子句时报错 / Errors when a clause does not start with case/default

p_try.return: `JS_N_TRY` 节点（kids: try 块、catch 子句/`NULL`、finally 块/`NULL`）/ A `JS_N_TRY` node (kids: try block, catch clause/`NULL`, finally block/`NULL`)
p_try.note: catch 子句的 kids[0] 为绑定目标（可为 `NULL`）/ The catch clause's kids[0] is the binding target (may be `NULL`)

p_export_list.brief: 解析 `export { a, b as c } [from "src"]` / Parse `export { a, b as c } [from "src"]`

params.ex: inout:导出节点 / The export node

p_export_list.note: 置 `ex->op=2`；kids[0] 为重导出列表，kids[1] 为来源模块或 `NULL` / Sets `ex->op=2`; kids[0] is the re-export list and kids[1] the source module or `NULL`

params.ex: inout:导出节点 / The export node

p_export_default.note: 置 `ex->op=1`；kids[0] 为被导出的值/声明 / Sets `ex->op=1`; kids[0] holds the exported value or declaration

p_export_star.brief: 解析 `export * [as ns] from "src"` / Parse `export * [as ns] from "src"`

params.ex: inout:导出节点 / The export node

p_export_star.note: 置 `ex->op=3`；带 `as ns` 时 `ex->num=1` 且 `ex->str` 为命名空间 / Sets `ex->op=3`; with `as ns`, `ex->num=1` and `ex->str` is the namespace
p_export_star.warning: 缺少 `from` 时报错 / Errors when `from` is missing

p_export.brief: 解析一条 `export` 声明 / Parse one `export` declaration
p_export.note: 按后续形态分派给 `{` 列表/`default`/`*` 或普通语句 / Dispatches on what follows to the `{` list, `default`, `*` or a plain statement

p_import_namespace.brief: 解析 `* as ns` 命名空间导入绑定 / Parse a `* as ns` namespace import binding

params.list: inout:导入绑定列表 / The import binding list

p_import_namespace.note: 绑定项 `op` 为 2 / The binding's `op` is 2
p_import_namespace.warning: 缺少 `as` 时报错 / Errors when `as` is missing

p_import_named.brief: 解析 `{ a, b as c }` 具名导入绑定 / Parse `{ a, b as c }` named import bindings

params.list: inout:导入绑定列表 / The import binding list

p_import_named.note: 绑定项 `op` 为 0，`str` 为本地名，kids[0] 为来源名 / The binding's `op` is 0, `str` is the local name and kids[0] the imported name

p_import_default.brief: 解析 `import name` 默认导入绑定 / Parse an `import name` default binding

params.list: inout:导入绑定列表 / The import binding list

p_import_default.note: 无默认导入时静默返回；绑定项 `op` 为 1 / Silently returns when there is no default; the binding's `op` is 1

p_import_decl.brief: 解析一条 `import` 声明 / Parse one `import` declaration
p_import_decl.note: 支持 `import "x"` 副作用导入（`op=1`）与默认/命名空间/具名组合 / Supports `import "x"` side-effect imports (`op=1`) and default/namespace/named combinations
p_import_decl.warning: 缺少 `from` 时报错 / Errors when `from` is missing

p_var_stmt.brief: 解析 `var`/`let`/`const` 声明语句 / Parse a `var`/`let`/`const` declaration statement
p_var_stmt.warning: 缺少 `;` 时报错 / Errors when `;` is missing

p_if_stmt.brief: 解析 `if (cond) stmt [else stmt]` / Parse `if (cond) stmt [else stmt]`
p_if_stmt.return: `JS_N_IF` 节点（kids: 条件、then、可选 else）/ A `JS_N_IF` node (kids: condition, then-branch, optional else-branch)

p_do_stmt.brief: 解析 `do stmt while (cond);` / Parse `do stmt while (cond);`
p_do_stmt.note: 结尾分号可省 / The trailing semicolon is optional
p_do_stmt.warning: 缺少 `while` 时报错 / Errors when `while` is missing

p_throw_stmt.warning: `throw` 后出现换行是语法错误 / A line terminator after `throw` is a syntax error

p_return_stmt.note: 下一词法单元换行时按自动分号插入处理，省略返回值 / Automatic semicolon insertion applies when the next token is on a new line, omitting the value

p_break_stmt.return: `JS_N_BREAK` 或 `JS_N_CONTINUE` 节点 / A `JS_N_BREAK` or `JS_N_CONTINUE` node
p_break_stmt.note: 标签须与关键字同行 / The label must be on the same line as the keyword

p_debugger_stmt.return: 一个 `JS_N_EMPTY` 占位节点 / A `JS_N_EMPTY` placeholder node

p_label_stmt.brief: 解析带标签语句 `ident: stmt` / Parse a labelled statement `ident: stmt`
p_label_stmt.note: 调用方已排除 `default:` 与 `case:` / The caller has already excluded `default:` and `case:`

p_function_stmt.brief: 解析 `function` / `async function` 声明 / Parse a `function` / `async function` declaration

params.is_async: async 声明为 1 / 1 for an async declaration

p_keyword_stmt.brief: 解析由关键字开头的语句 / Resolve statements that begin with a keyword
p_keyword_stmt.return: 对应的语句节点；普通表达式开头时返回 `NULL` / The matching statement node, or `NULL` when the token is an ordinary expression start

p_statement.brief: 解析一条语句 / Parse one statement
p_statement.return: 块、空语句、标签、关键字语句或表达式语句节点 / A block, empty, labelled, keyword or expression statement node
p_statement.note: `{` 后跟标识符加 `:`（非 default/case）视为标签语句 / `{` is a block; an identifier followed by `:` (other than default/case) is a label

parse_common.brief: 词法分析与解析的共用入口 / Shared entry point for lexing and parsing

params.module: 按 ES 模块标记为 1 / 1 to mark the program as an ES module

parse_common.return: 语句块根节点（`op` 标记是否模块）/ The statement-block root node (`op` marks module mode)
parse_common.note: 先 `lex_all` 再循环 `p_statement` 直到 `T_EOF` / Runs `lex_all` then loops `p_statement` until `T_EOF`

js_parse_program.brief: 把脚本文本解析成程序 AST / Parse script text into a program AST
js_parse_program.return: 程序语句块根节点（脚本模式）/ The program statement-block root (script mode)
js_parse_program.note: 等价于 `parse_common(js, source, 0)` / Equivalent to `parse_common(js, source, 0)`

js_parse_module.brief: 把模块文本解析成模块 AST / Parse module text into a module AST
js_parse_module.return: 程序语句块根节点（模块模式）/ The program statement-block root (module mode)
js_parse_module.note: 等价于 `parse_common(js, source, 1)` / Equivalent to `parse_common(js, source, 1)`

js_parse_expression.brief: 把独立表达式源码解析成 AST / Parse a standalone expression source into an AST
js_parse_expression.return: 表达式根节点 / The expression root node
js_parse_expression.note: 供模块加载器与 DOM 桥复用 / Exported for the module loader and the DOM bridge
